key_points: Amazon shipping volume reduction is the primary driver of a 4.35% single-day decline, making UPS the worst S&P 500 performer on a day when markets rose overall
BofA reiterated Neutral rating but cut price target to $108 (from $115), full-year EPS to $7.10 (from $7.25), and 2026 revenue to $91.3B (from $92.5B)
Estimate cuts are modest in magnitude, suggesting incremental concern rather than a structural thesis break; stock at $94.75 still trades below the revised $108 PT
Retail bull sentiment remains intact on dividend yield thesis, creating a potential divergence between institutional and retail positioning
The Amazon volume headwind represents a material multi-week overhang as the market digests implications for UPS's domestic package volumes and pricing power
